content.short: Meshpay accepts crypto payments from 300+ wallets and exchanges, settling in stablecoins or fiat.
content.description: Meshpay lets merchants accept payment directly from a customer's existing exchange or wallet account across several hundred venues, settling in stablecoins or local currency. Pulling funds from where users already keep them sidesteps the withdraw-then-pay sequence that loses a large share of transactions.
content.meta: Take payment from a customer's existing exchange or wallet account, settling in stablecoins or fiat.
